title: Stock Market Today Highlights, Oct 8: Sensex tanks 1,045 pts, Nifty sheds 371 pts to close lower - The HinduBusinessLine
text:
Candle stick graph chart of stock market investment trading, Stock exchange concept design and background. Vector illustrations. | Photo Credit: EMOJOEZ

Sensex Today, Nifty 50 | Stock Market Highlights - Find here all the updates related to Sensex, Nifty, BSE, NSE, share prices and Indian stock markets for 8 October 2026

Benchmark stock index Sensex tanked 1,045 points while Nifty slid to near 22,230 level on Thursday following heavy selling in rate-sensitive, commodities and FMCG shares amid a sharp spike in crude oil prices and growing prospect of tighter domestic and global monetary conditions.

Falling for the second day running, the 30-share BSE Sensex tumbled 1,045.46 points, or 1.44 per cent, to settle at 71,593.24. During the day, it slumped 1,310.95 points, or 1.80 per cent, to 71,327.75.

Brent crude, the global oil benchmark, jumped 4.25 per cent to USD 104.5 per barrel.

The Reserve Bank of India raised its benchmark repo rate by 25 basis points to 5.50 per cent on Wednesday, its first hike in nearly four years, while signalling that rate cuts are off the table in the near term and that further hikes could follow amid rising inflation, a weak rupee and high crude oil prices.
